stage_entry.text: 体位、左开胸侧别和全麻状态已确认，开始进入。
stage_entry.text_en: Position, left-sided thoracotomy, and general anesthesia are confirmed. Begin entry.

stage_entry.text: 通气与血流动力学监测正常，继续按计划进行。
stage_entry.text_en: Ventilation and hemodynamic monitoring are stable. Proceed as planned.

stage_entry.text: 先标记病变主动脉和周围组织的关系。
stage_entry.text_en: Map the diseased aortic segment and its relationship to nearby structures.

stage_entry.text: 食管与邻近神经区域已经辨认，维持保护。
stage_entry.text_en: The esophageal and adjacent neural areas have been identified and protected.

stage_entry.text: 近远端控制区必须可靠，不能从脆弱的瘤壁直接牵拉。
stage_entry.text_en: Proximal and distal control zones must be secure. Do not pull directly on the fragile aneurysm wall.

stage_entry.text: 我保持瘤体外侧暴露，等待控制区确认。
stage_entry.text_en: I'll maintain exposure outside the aneurysm while we verify the control zones.

precision_failed.text: 近端控制区暴露不足，不能在这种条件下推进。
precision_failed.text_en: The proximal control zone isn't exposed adequately. Do not advance under these conditions.

precision_failed.text: 分离界面靠近重要邻接结构，先重新确认边界。
precision_failed.text_en: The dissection plane approaches a critical adjacent structure. Recheck the boundary.

stage_entry.text: 夹闭前先核对远端灌注与脊髓供血保护方案。
stage_entry.text_en: Before clamping, recheck distal perfusion and spinal-cord protection.

stage_entry.text: 灌注与循环监测已报告，继续复核关键项目。
stage_entry.text_en: Perfusion and circulatory monitoring are reported. Continue the critical checks.

stage_entry.text: 远端支持已建立，按计划分阶段控制主动脉。
stage_entry.text_en: Distal support is established. Control the aorta in planned stages.

stage_entry.text: 近远端压力持续监测，任何波动会立即报告。
stage_entry.text_en: Proximal and distal pressures are being monitored continuously. We will report any change.

precision_failed.text: 夹闭阶段的压力反应不理想，先调整控制条件。
precision_failed.text_en: The pressure response to clamping is unsatisfactory. Adjust the control conditions first.

precision_failed.text: 远端灌注指标不稳定，暂缓后续步骤。
precision_failed.text_en: Distal perfusion is unstable. Delay the next stage.

stage_entry.text: 病变范围与人工血管规格再次确认，只处理胸降段。
stage_entry.text_en: Confirm the diseased segment and graft size. The repair is confined to the descending thoracic aorta.

stage_entry.text: 人工血管、血管缝线和备用止血材料已就位。
stage_entry.text_en: The graft, vascular sutures, and backup hemostatic materials are ready.

stage_entry.text: 近端吻合开始，重点看整圈对合和吻合线张力。
stage_entry.text_en: Begin proximal anastomosis. Watch the circumferential alignment and suture tension.

stage_entry.text: 我会保持吻合区稳定暴露，避免移植物扭转。
stage_entry.text_en: I'll keep the anastomosis stable and avoid graft twisting.

precision_failed.text: 近端吻合口张力不均，需要重新检查整圈对合。
precision_failed.text_en: The proximal anastomosis has uneven tension. Recheck the full circumference.

precision_failed.text: 吻合处仍有渗漏风险，先调整缝合线。
precision_failed.text_en: The anastomosis may still leak. Revise the suture line first.

stage_entry.text: 这组关键肋间动脉需要保护并按既定方案重接。
stage_entry.text_en: These critical intercostal arteries must be protected and reattached according to the case plan.

stage_entry.text: 神经监测与远端灌注指标持续记录中。
stage_entry.text_en: Neuromonitoring and distal perfusion indicators are being recorded.

precision_failed.text: 关键分支的灌注尚未确认，不能结束这一步。
precision_failed.text_en: Perfusion through the critical branch isn't confirmed. This step isn't complete.

precision_failed.text: 神经监测提示需要复核分支重接与保护。
precision_failed.text_en: Neuromonitoring calls for reassessment of branch reattachment and protection.

stage_entry.text: 远端吻合继续，确认移植物走向自然、没有过度张力。
stage_entry.text_en: Continue the distal anastomosis. Verify natural graft alignment and no excessive tension.

stage_entry.text: 远端血管缘已稳定暴露，可以逐段检查。
stage_entry.text_en: The distal vessel edge is stably exposed for a segment-by-segment check.

precision_failed.text: 远端吻合位置存在张力，先调整移植物走向。
precision_failed.text_en: The distal anastomosis is under tension. Adjust the graft's orientation first.

precision_failed.text: 吻合线完整性有疑点，不能直接进入复灌。
precision_failed.text_en: Anastomotic integrity is uncertain. Do not proceed directly to reperfusion.

stage_entry.text: 按计划逐步复灌，并复核两端吻合口。
stage_entry.text_en: Restore flow in planned stages and inspect both anastomoses.

stage_entry.text: 循环变化正在监测。请继续分阶段恢复血流。
stage_entry.text_en: Hemodynamic changes are under observation. Continue staged reperfusion.

precision_failed.text: 复灌时循环波动偏大，先稳定血流条件。
precision_failed.text_en: Hemodynamic swings during reperfusion are excessive. Stabilize flow conditions first.

precision_failed.text: 吻合区出现新的出血疑点，重新检查后再继续。
precision_failed.text_en: There is concern for new bleeding at the anastomosis. Inspect it before continuing.

stage_entry.text: 确认远端脉搏、相关神经指标、出血情况和清点结果。
stage_entry.text_en: Confirm distal pulses, relevant neurologic measures, bleeding status, and instrument counts.

stage_entry.text: 记录与计数复核已进入最终确认。
stage_entry.text_en: Documentation and final counts are being verified.

stage_entry.text: 安置引流，准备分层关胸并交接恢复团队。
stage_entry.text_en: Place the drains, close the chest in layers, and prepare recovery handoff.

stage_entry.text: 关胸器械准备完成，交接清单包括远端灌注观察。
stage_entry.text_en: Chest-closure instruments are ready. The handover includes distal perfusion monitoring.
